text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, this is cheap. And meat can go<n>in the freezer,
so I could stock up<n>now...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This other store has pretty good<n>bargains, too. Plus
they only advertise<n>their sales on their website, so
that<n>means less shoppers to compete<n>with...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, where should I go... Maybe I<n>should decide
what to cook first.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, everyone said they enjoyed<n>the curry I
made the other day, so<n>let's start there...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...All right, that's the plan settled! This<n>shopping trip
is going to go great!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ack, how is it this late already?! Oh<n>man, I got
carried away...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Ines Fujin has been<n>staying up late
recently...
